Class ItemIcons

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.ItemIcons
public final class ItemIcons extends Object
Item ids that are safe to draw. The plugins use Coins' coin items as pictures (help topics, settings rows, default crate and quest icons); on a server without Coins those items do not exist, so a similar item from the game is drawn instead. 
cmd.set("#Icon.ItemId", ItemIcons.safe("Coin_Gold"));   // the gold coin, or a gold bar without Coins
